notes: Income limits come from the page and may change. The page lists regional boards across the state for other areas.
name: Jobs League Program
what_you_do: Paid on-the-job training of up to 320 hours. Jobs listed include cashier, child care center, nursing assistant, retail and food service.
who_can_apply: Ages 14 to 24 who live in Missouri. Your household must meet the income limit (for example, gross monthly income of $2,413 or less for a household of 1, $4,109 for 3, $4,957 for 4).
pay_detail: Paid training. Up to 320 hours. Wage not stated.
deadline_text: The page does not list a deadline. Call and ask to speak with a Youth Specialist at a Missouri Workforce Development Board near you.
how_to_apply: Call and ask for a Youth Specialist at your regional workforce board. Examples listed: Full Employment Council in Kansas City 816-471-2330 ext. 1256, St. Louis City 314-657-3557, Workforce Development Board of St. Louis County 314-615-6010.
